description: Read payrolls. With payroll_id: that payroll's status, dates, and each employee's gross pay, every deduction (federal, Social Security, Medicare, state, local), net pay, and employer taxes. Without payroll_id: the household's payrolls, newest first, with totals. Use it to confirm what run_payroll created. Read-only.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

payroll_id.description: A payroll id from run_payroll. Leave it out to list payrolls.

name: get_payroll
